title: Sail The DREAM Boat From South Beach
includes: Bottled water, fresh ice, clean towels
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
MIAMI is made to be seen from the water and there is no better way than to sail on DREAMER, our lovely 52’ Sea Ray Sundancer! She is beautifully equipped for day trips to every corner of Biscayne Bay giving you the opportunity to experience some of that awesomeness that is south Florida…

Visit a sandbar or quiet lagoon, family fun or celebrations with friends, company outings or adventure tours, we have something for everyone!

DREAMER has plenty of space, she’s always clean and fresh, and she’s crewed and maintained by professionals who love boats.

So pick a day, get your crew, step on board… IT’S THAT SIMPLE. Fun and relaxation are already here waiting for you!
